title: my_gamer_tag_on_a_missing_poster
display_title: I found my Minecraft username printed on a missing person poster in real life
share_line: Send this to the one friend who still plays your old server.
beats: My exact Minecraft username was printed on a missing person flyer stapled to a telephone pole three blocks from my house.
Not close. Not similar. Exact spelling, exact capitalization, the underscore and all — a name I made up when I was eleven.
The poster said the person went missing in 2019, the same year I started my parkour server.
I ran home and pulled up my old world, the one I hadn't opened in five years.
There was a new structure at spawn that I never built — a sign with today's date on it.
I asked my two oldest server friends if they'd logged in recently. Both said the same thing: 'I thought that was you.'
I checked the poster again that night to get a clearer photo of the face. The pole was empty. No staples, no tear marks, nothing.
I still have the screenshot of that sign, timestamped an hour before I ever opened the world that day. What was already in there before me?
